biz.summary: Jensen Huang, who has come under fire for admitting to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent, has been accused of having a separate affair with an Nvidia subordinate.

biz.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
biz.summary: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay up front, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.

biz.title: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
biz.summary: Fractile has now become one of the top-funded players in the race for purpose-built AI chips.

biz.title: Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair
biz.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has until the end of the day Wednesday to answer a call from House Republicans for a closed-door briefing on his affair with alleged Chinese spy.

biz.title: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
biz.summary: Sales of $10 billion represents an almost 50% jump from revenue of $6.7 billion the company recorded in the second quarter.

biz.title: Databricks’ new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
biz.summary: With Databricks at 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.

biz.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
biz.summary: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.

biz.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
biz.summary: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

biz.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
biz.summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

biz.title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development
